Details
Raid
Alliance boss content. Dark Knight Sky scales across 100 levels; the damage you deal feeds personal leagues and the alliance ranking.
OPEN GUIDE →
World Boss
Server-wide boss content. Cerberus scales across 100 levels; your total damage decides league placement and rewards.
OPEN GUIDE →
Arena
Ticket-based PvP with seven opponent slots. Wins and losses move Arena Points, which decide league placement and ranking rewards.
OPEN GUIDE →
Tools & guides
NEW
Farming simulator

Compare cleared stages by Gold and EXP per hour using measured runs or an effective DPS estimate.

NEW
Leveling Calculator

Enter your level, a farming stage and run time: EXP needed, clears required and the time to reach your target level.

Combat Calculator

Pick a character, add bonuses, choose a monster: hit chance, crit chance, damage, DPS and time-to-kill from the exact in-game formulas.

Stats & Formulas

All exported ability types with their in-game names, plus every Final_* formula and the combat power formula.

Characters

Base stats, owned and equipped effects, unlock costs and computed combat power for all 33 characters.

Skills

Class skill trees with per-level values, cooldowns, costs and the effect rows behind each description.

Equipment

1,872 gear and accessory rows with abilities, level requirements, jewel slots, dismantle values and drop sources.

Growth Systems

User levels, diamond production, Training Ground, Altar, synthesis and equipment level reduction tables.
